infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ClaimsGuru needs access to your camera to capture and attach medical bills and discharge summaries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ClaimsGuru needs access to your photos to attach existing medical documents and reports.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you upload claim documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you take photos of medical receipts and claim documents.
